method: Candidate tee centres are placed only where the authenticated Lantmateriet 1 m DTM resolves a constructed bench, then checked against the supplementary OSM road geometry and corroborated against the official/Caddee three-deck hole guide. DTM morphology and guide art are not a boundary survey, so every control remains provisional.

controls.cardDistanceStatus: official-total-constrained provisional per-hole metadata; not inferred from this spatial control
